en: A vintage sepia-tone postcard depicting a striking Eastern Orthodox cathedral with distinctive domes and crosses, surrounded by several buildings and a fenced garden area. There are horse-drawn carriages and sparse trees along the unpaved road in the foreground, indicative of an early 20th-century setting. The text at the top provides the location in three languages.
